name: 5-MeO-MPMI
summary: 5-MeO-MPMI (developmental code name CP-108509), also known as 5-methoxy-N-methyl-(α,N-trimethylene)tryptamine, is a psychedelic drug of the pyrrolidinylmethylindole and cyclized tryptamine families.

pharmacology.text: 5-MeO-MPMI produces psychedelic-appropriate responding in animal tests, with similar potency to DOI. It has two enantiomers, with only the (R)-enantiomer being active.

uses.en: It is a research compound developed in the pharmaceutical industry and studied in animals.
uses.zh: 它是製藥業開發的研究用化合物，曾在動物身上進行研究。
uses.zhHans: 它是制药业开发的研究用化合物，曾在动物身上进行研究。

fact.en: Its amine is tied back into the molecule to form a rigid ring, and only one of its two mirror-image forms is active, a neat demonstration that receptors recognise shape and not just composition.
fact.zh: 它的胺基被反折回分子中形成一個僵硬的環，而它兩種互為鏡像的形式中只有一種有活性，清楚說明受體辨認的是形狀，而不只是組成。
fact.zhHans: 它的胺基被反折回分子中形成一个僵硬的环，而它两种互为镜像的形式中只有一种有活性，清楚说明受体辨认的是形状，而不只是组成。
